same distributor model but different product lines."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Makes pumps, filters, heaters and sanitizers sold to pool builders and service companies, the same products and customers as the target."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Designs heating, cooling and refrigeration equipment for buildings and food retailers, unrelated to pool supplies."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Builds recreational boats sold to consumers through boat dealers, a different product and customer base from pool trade."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Makes chlor-alkali chemicals and sells ammunition to industrial, retail and government buyers, not pool supplies."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures roofing shingles, insulation and glass fiber for builders and contractors, differing in products from pool supplies."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Makes structural connectors, anchors and fasteners for home builders and framing contractors, unrelated to pool products."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Quarries limestone and makes cement and ready-mix concrete for construction firms in the Midwest, not pool supplies."},{"label":"C15","good":false,"reason":"Makes lawn mowers, snow blowers and irrigation equipment for landscapers and homeowners, overlapping only partly in irrigation with the target."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Makes commercial plumbing fixtures and water coolers for non-residential buildings, a different product set from pool supplies."}]}
